references.text: Describes the same pattern for Levitical cities with pasturelands around them, establishing the principle that each city should have surrounding grazing land.
The introduction to the chapter explaining why the Levites were to receive cities with pasturelands from the other tribes, as fulfillment of God's command.
Notes that the Levites received no inheritance in the land, but cities to live in along with pasturelands for their livestock.
Parallel account in Chronicles listing the same Levitical cities and their pasturelands.
The Levites' right to redeem their houses in the cities and the provision that the pasturelands around the cities could not be sold.
